why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (convenient, dense, pharmacy-centred drugstores run on profit per customer visit) and its brutal facts, with Analysis 1 slightly closer on clustered corner sites. Analysis 2 commits to a phased exit from all food service and the discount stores, where Analysis 1 only freezes restaurant growth and keeps the lunch counters under test, and Analysis 2 is also more explicit about its confidence and what missing division data could change.
